segment_contamination_dimensions: Residential/lifestyle home buyers (Log Homes, Wooden House, Prefabricated Beach House, Prefabricated Guest House, Container Homes, Modular Cottages, Portable Resort buyers) — these are permanent or semi-permanent dwelling buyers, not B2B project-site labour accommodation procurers; names implying home living, resort, guest, cottage, or leisure use are blocked

Single-occupant security/guard post buyers (Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts) — buyer persona is facility security procurement, not multi-worker labour colony procurement; names implying guard, sentry, or security post use are blocked

Office/workspace-only buyers (Bunk House Office sibling) — buyers seeking site offices without sleeping/accommodation function; names implying office-only use without accommodation context are blocked

Material-specific sibling MCATs that carve out sub-segments already named (MS Bunkhouse, Prefab Steel Bunk House, Mild Steel Portable House) — enhanced names and alt names must not exactly replicate these sibling MCAT names to avoid collision
